question: In covering a distance of 110 km, Pranay takes 6 hours more than Aman. If Pranay doubles his speed, then he would take 5 hours less than Aman. Pranay's speed is:
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 110 km

Pranay takes 6 hours more than Aman

If Pranay doubles his speed, he takes 5 hours less than Aman

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

Let Pranay’s speed = p

Let Aman’s speed = a

⇒ 110/p = 110/a + 6 …(1)

⇒ 110/(2p) = 110/a − 5 …(2)

Subtract (2) from (1):

⇒ 110/p − 110/(2p) = 6 − (−5)

⇒ 110 × (1/p − 1/(2p)) = 11

⇒ 110 × (1/(2p)) = 11

⇒ 110 ÷ (2p) = 11

⇒ 110 = 22p

⇒ p = 5

**∴ Pranay’s speed is 5 km/h.**
